segments.title: Stop WhatsApp spam calls
segments.say: WhatsApp has a setting that stops calls from strangers ringing your phone.

segments.title: Turn it on here
segments.say: Open WhatsApp settings, then Privacy, then Calls, and turn it on.

segments.title: Still in your call list
segments.say: Silenced calls won't ring, but they still show in your call list.

segments.title: Miss nothing important
segments.say: So you can still call back anyone you need.

segments.sub: to the friend who gets spam calls
segments.say: Send this to the friend who gets spam calls.
